harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Set up a nightly backup of /srv/inventory/data from node2 to node1, storing dated tar.gz archives under /var/backups/inventory on node1 with 7-day retention via a cron job (02:00 daily). Fixed sshd on node2 (missing host keys and /run/sshd tmpfiles rule) to enable the pull-based SSH transfer, established passwordless SSH auth via the cluster keypair, and populated /etc/hosts on node1 for reliable hostname resolution under cron. Verified retention logic by seeding 8 days of dated archives and confirming exactly 7 remained after pruning. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: restarted node1 and node2 one at a time, confirmed changed boot IDs on both, and verified post-restart recovery (cron active with job intact, sshd active and listening on node2, source data intact, and a full end-to-end backup run succeeding after both restarts).
actions_performed: Created /srv/inventory/data with sample inventory.csv on node2 (source directory did not exist)
Fixed sshd on node2: generated missing host keys (ssh-keygen -A), created /run/sshd, added /etc/tmpfiles.d/sshd.conf for persistence across reboots, enabled+started ssh.service
Configured passwordless SSH from node1 to node2 using CLUSTER_SSH_PRIVKEY/PUBKEY and authorized_keys
Added node1/node2 entries to /etc/hosts on node1 from CLUSTER_HOSTS for cron-safe hostname resolution
Wrote /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory.sh on node1: SSH-pulls a tar.gz of /srv/inventory/data from node2, writes dated archive to /var/backups/inventory, prunes archives older than 7 days
Installed crontab entry on node1: 0 2 * * * /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory.sh >> /var/log/inventory-backup.log 2>&1
Manually ran the backup script and verified archive contents via tar -tzv
Seeded 8 days of synthetic dated archives (touch -d) and re-ran the script to prove retention deletes only archives older than 7 days, leaving exactly 7
Verified cron's root environment (HOME=/root) matches the SSH key/known_hosts location used by the script
Captured healthy baseline (boot_id, service status, data) on both nodes
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified cron active with job intact and backup dir persisted, re-ran backup script successfully
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified sshd active/listening on :22 (proving tmpfiles fix persisted) and source data intact
Ran a final end-to-end backup from node1 after both restarts to confirm full pipeline recovery

evidence.requirement: Nightly backup mechanism configured (cron 02:00 on node1 pulling from node2)
evidence.summary: Crontab installed with backup-inventory.sh script content shown

evidence.requirement: Backup produces dated archive under /var/backups/inventory on node1 with correct source data

8 seeded dated archives (08-26 through 09-02) plus new run; after script execution only 7 most recent (08-28 through 09-03) remained, oldest two pruned

evidence.requirement: SSH connectivity from node1 to node2 established and durable
evidence.summary: sshd fixed on node2 (host keys + tmpfiles rule for /run/sshd) and passwordless auth verified node1->node2
boot_id 29011044..., cron active with job, backup file present

evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node unreachable during reboot; reconnected with new boot_id 3ac58281...; cron/job/backup dir/hosts entries intact; backup script re-ran successfully post-reboot
boot_id 1e0cb179..., sshd active, source data present with expected content

evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node unreachable during reboot; reconnected with new boot_id f5b20e8d...; sshd active/listening on :22 (confirms tmpfiles persistence fix), source data intact; final end-to-end backup from node1 succeeded post-restart
